Асуултын цэгийн $(u,v)$ утгад $u-u_{min}$, $u_{max}-u$, $v-v_{min}$, $v_{max}-v$ дөрвийн хамгийн ихийг хэвлэнэ.
Цэгүүд $(0,0),(2,1),(-1,3)$ байг. Эхний цэгээс зай $3$ ба $4$, тэгэхээр хариу $4$. Хувиргасан $u$ утгууд $0,3,2$, $v$ утгууд $0,1,-4$ тул дөрвөн зөрүүний хамгийн их нь мөн $4$.

$dx,dy$ ижил тэмдэгтэй бол $|dx+dy|=|dx|+|dy|$; эсрэг тэмдэгтэй бол $|dx-dy|=|dx|+|dy|$. Triangle inequality-гаар нөгөө утга энэ нийлбэрээс ихгүй. Тиймээс хувиргасан max нь Manhattan distance-тэй яг тэнцэнэ.

Бүх цэг дээр $|u-u_i|$-г хамгийн их болгоход $u_i$-ийн хамгийн бага эсвэл хамгийн их утга хангалттай. $v$-д мөн адил. Нийт max нь хоёр координатын эдгээр дөрвөн туйлын зөрүүнээс олдоно; бүх цэгийг асуулт бүрд дахин шалгах шаардлагагүй.

Хувиргалт ба min/max $O(N)$, асуулт бүр $O(1)$; нийт $O(N+Q)$ хугацаа, $O(N)$ санах ой. $x,y$ нь $\pm10^9$ хүрэх тул distance $4\cdot10^9$ болж болно. Координатын хувиргалт болон зөрүүнүүдийг ll-д хадгална. Цэгүүд болон асуултын индексүүд тус тус ялгаатай.

Set $u=x+y$ and $v=x-y$. Manhattan distance becomes $\max(|u_1-u_2|,|v_1-v_2|)$. Only the global minimum and maximum of each transformed coordinate are needed for every query.
For query coordinates $(u,v)$, take the maximum of $u-u_{min}$, $u_{max}-u$, $v-v_{min}$ and $v_{max}-v$.
For points $(0,0),(2,1),(-1,3)$, distances from the first are $3$ and $4$. The transformed coordinates are $u=[0,3,2]$ and $v=[0,1,-4]$, whose four extreme differences also give $4$.

When $dx,dy$ have the same sign, $|dx+dy|=|dx|+|dy|$; with opposite signs, $|dx-dy|$ equals that sum. The triangle inequality bounds the other expression by the same sum, proving the transform identity.

The greatest $|u-u_i|$ over all points is attained at the minimum or maximum $u_i$, and likewise for $v$. Maximizing the distance over all points therefore reduces exactly to the four extreme differences.

Preprocessing takes $O(N)$, each query $O(1)$, total $O(N+Q)$ time and $O(N)$ space. With coordinates as large as $\pm10^9$, a distance reaches $4\cdot10^9$, so transformed values and differences use ll. Points and query indices are each pairwise distinct.

The path $1-2-3-4$ has edge splits $1/3$, $2/2$, and $3/1$, contributing $3,4,3$ for total $10$. This equals the six unordered-pair distances $1+2+3+1+2+1$.

blocks.text: A tree has one path between each pair. An edge lies on that path exactly when the two endpoints lie on opposite sides of its removal. Choosing one vertex on each side gives $s(N-s)$ unordered pairs, with no further division by two.
Summing over edges counts every edge of every pair’s path once. Each pair therefore contributes exactly its distance, giving the required total.
The traversal order places parents before children. Processing it backward passes child sizes to their parents only after those child subtrees are complete, so all subtree sizes are correct.

Time and space are $O(N)$. Iterative traversal avoids deep recursion. The ll subtree size promotes the product before multiplication. A path of $100000$ vertices has sum $N(N^2-1)/6=166666666650000$, which does not fit int.
Parents and traversal order
In a tree, every neighbor except the parent is a child. Grow order as a vector queue, appending each vertex once.
Reverse accumulation
Skip the root, add each child-edge contribution, then pass its subtree size to the parent.

$dp[s]$ нь нийлбэр $s$-тэй цифрийн дарааллын тоо. $dp[0]=1$ нь хоосон prefix байгуулах ганц арга; эцсийн $K\ge1$ учир хоосон тоо хариунд орохгүй. Сүүлийн цифр $d$ бүрээр $dp[s-d]$ нэмнэ.

$K=9$ үед $9$ ширхэг нэгийг таслалуудтай бүлэглэх аргаар бүх positive composition үүснэ. Найман завсар бүрт таслах/таслахгүй сонголт байгаа тул $2^8=256$. Аль ч хэсэг $9$-өөс ихгүй. $K=8$ бол digit sum нь $9$-д хуваагдахгүй тул $0$.

Цифрийн дараалал бүрийн сүүлийн цифр ганц $d\in[1,9]$ утгатай. Түүнийг хасвал нийлбэр $s-d$-тэй prefix үлдэнэ. Эсрэгээр ийм prefix бүрд $d$-г залгахад нэг шинэ дараалал үүснэ. Сүүлийн цифрийн бүлгүүд давхцахгүй тул recurrence бүх дарааллыг яг нэг удаа тоолно.

Тэг цифр зөвшөөрөгдөөгүй учир бүх цифр эерэг, leading zero ч байхгүй. Иймээс дараалал бүр нэг эерэг бүхэл тоог төлөөлнө. $K$ нь $9$-д хуваагдсан үед тоологдсон бүх тоо divisible by $9$ байх ба өөр нэмэлт шалгалт хэрэггүй.
Хугацаа $O(9K)$, санах ой $O(K)$. dp нь modulo $10^9+7$ утгууд тул int-д багтана. Харин нэг төлөвт есөн residue-ийн нийлбэр int-ээс их болж болох тул ways-ийг ll авч, mod-ийн дараа int болгоно.

Divisibility by $9$ depends on the digit sum. If $K$ is not divisible by $9$, return zero. Otherwise count sequences of digits $1$ through $9$ summing to $K$ using DP.

Let $dp[s]$ count digit sequences with sum $s$. Set $dp[0]=1$ for the unique empty prefix; since the final $K\ge1$, this does not count an empty integer. Append each possible last digit $d$, adding $dp[s-d]$.
For $K=9$, group nine ones by choosing cuts among eight gaps. Every resulting positive part is at most nine, so there are $2^8=256$ sequences. For $K=8$, divisibility fails and the answer is zero.

Every nonempty sequence has a unique last digit $d\in[1,9]$. Removing it leaves a prefix of sum $s-d$, and appending it reverses this operation. Groups for different last digits are disjoint, so the recurrence counts every sequence exactly once.

Zero digits are forbidden, so every digit is positive and no leading zero exists. Each sequence represents one positive integer. When $K$ is divisible by $9$, every counted integer automatically satisfies the divisibility requirement.
Time is $O(9K)$ and space $O(K)$. Modular dp values fit int. The sum of nine residues can exceed int, so accumulate ways in ll and convert after taking the modulus.

blocks.text: For $A=[0,1]$, $B=[0,45]$, $C=[0,46]$, both C entries have residue zero. Pairs $(0,0)$ and $(1,45)$ each contribute two choices, giving four total. Equal residues still represent separate index choices.
Divisibility of the sum depends only on the three residues, and each pair of first/second residues requires exactly one third residue.

Indices are chosen independently from the arrays, so the number of triples in these three groups is the product of their frequencies. Distinct residue pairs partition the possible triples, counting every qualifying index triple exactly once.

Time is $O(N+46^2)$ and auxiliary space is $O(46)$, a constant. The answer may reach $N^3\le10^{15}$. Store frequencies in ll so promotion occurs before multiplication; converting an already-overflowed int product afterward would be too late.
Three residue histograms
Read the three arrays separately, incrementing residue counters without storing the original values. {} zero-initializes every counter.
Two loops and products
No third loop is needed because $k$ follows from $i,j$. The ll counters keep every product in the safe type.
